technical.summary: Long-term trend structure is bullish (50/200 EMA, supertrend) with MACD crossover confirmation, but short-term price action remains below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, creating mixed confluence and moderate entry risk.

fundamental.summary: IR shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings volatility in 7 days—fundamentally weak signal.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (27/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and stale trading data (281+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis-level VIX (328.48) combined with critical earnings event in 7 days creates extreme binary risk; normal yield curve provides minimal offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure (50/200 EMA bullish, supertrend bullish, MACD crossover) with price near support (54.36) offers contrarian entry in extreme fear zone (VIX crisis level).
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings event in 7 days combined with crisis-level VIX, zero fundamental conviction (no insider/institutional buying), price below all short-term MAs, and Ichimoku cloud rejection create unacceptable binary risk that outweighs technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term trend structure (50/200 EMA bullish, supertrend, MACD crossover) with price at support offers technical setup, but critical earnings event in 7 days and crisis-level VIX create unacceptable binary risk that negates entry merit.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement within 7 days combined with crisis-level VIX (328.48) creates extreme volatility and binary outcome risk; price rejection below short-term MAs and Ichimoku cloud suggests weak near-term momentum.
